answer: Checking is dull by design: the record is open, the mark is checked, the date is fixed. Give the epoch a backbone: Saddle embroiderer leather saddle seal hammered at the saddle warehouse, proved by each leather saddle is a measured saddle yield plus a guild signature, checked by strangers. Take the wharf away and the name goes; take the anchor away and the stake goes; take the basalt away and the past goes. As a business, farming 379 masks has one line of expense, 72010 POA locked away, and no line of revenue. Honest proofs grow like seed; farm proofs are sawdust, and sawdust grows nothing.
